5.0.0 - 13-08-2026 Full code rewrite. Requires Node >=22. Use native fetch. Replaced xml-js with fast-xml-parser. Removed smart-request-balancer dependency. Fixed getWANDNSLookUpStatus, GetConnectionTypeInfoResponse, GetDNSLookUpStatusResponse and getCurrentBandwidthByMAC. Added getAllSatellites, getWPASecurityKeys, get5GWPASecurityKeys, get5G1WPASecurityKeys and getAllMACAddresses. Added automated unit test suite. NetgearRouter now extends EventEmitter and emits a 'log' event with a configurable logLevel, for richer diagnostics without writing to the console directly.
